story.text: 그다음 달, 하늘은 난생처음 콘서트장이라는 곳에 발을 들였다. 표를 구하는 데만 꼬박 며칠이 걸렸다는 건 아무에게도 말하지 않았다.
story.reading: geu-da-eum dal, ha-neul-eun nan-saeng-cheo-eum kon-seo-teu-jang-i-ra-neun gos-e bal-eul deul-yeoss-da. pyo-reul gu-ha-neun de-man kko-bak myeoch il-i geol-lyeoss-da-neun geon a-mu-e-ge-do mal-ha-ji anh-ass-da.
story.en: The following month, Haneul set foot inside a concert venue for the very first time in his life. He told no one that it had taken him a solid few days just to get a ticket.

story.text: 태어나서 처음 와보는 콘서트였다. 사방에서 쏟아지는 조명과 음악에, 그는 잠시 정신을 차리지 못했다.
story.reading: tae-eo-na-seo cheo-eum wa-bo-neun kon-seo-teu-i-eoss-da. sa-bang-e-seo ssod-a-ji-neun jo-myeong-gwa eum-ag-e, geu-neun jam-si jeong-sin-eul cha-ri-ji mos-haess-da.
story.en: It was his first concert ever. Surrounded by lights and music pouring in from every direction, he was momentarily overwhelmed.

story.text: 그녀의 이름이 불리는 순간, 공연장 전체가 함성으로 뒤덮였다. 하늘은 그 소리에 몸이 저릿해지는 걸 느꼈다.
story.reading: geu-nyeo-ui i-reum-i bul-li-neun sun-gan, gong-yeon-jang jeon-che-ga ham-seong-eu-ro dwi-deop-yeoss-da. ha-neul-eun geu so-ri-e mom-i jeo-rit-hae-ji-neun geol neu-kkyeoss-da.
story.en: The instant her name was called, the entire venue erupted in one massive roar. Haneul felt a shiver run through his body at the sound.

story.text: 무대 위에 선 그녀는, 그가 알던 모습과는 완전히 다른 사람 같았다. 수만 개의 시선을 받으면서도 조금도 흔들리지 않았다.
story.reading: mu-dae wi-e seon geu-nyeo-neun, geu-ga al-deon mo-seub-gwa-neun wan-jeon-hi da-reun sa-ram gat-ass-da. su-man gae-ui si-seon-eul bad-eu-myeon-seo-do jo-geum-do heun-deul-li-ji anh-ass-da.
story.en: Standing on that stage, she seemed like an entirely different person from the one he knew. Even under tens of thousands of eyes, she never wavered, not once.

story.text: 조명 아래에서 그녀는 빛났다. 하늘은 그 순간, 자신이 지금껏 알던 게 이 사람의 아주 작은 조각에 불과했다는 걸 깨달았다.
story.reading: jo-myeong a-rae-e-seo geu-nyeo-neun bit-nass-da. ha-neul-eun geu sun-gan, ja-sin-i ji-geum-kkeot al-deon ge i sa-ram-ui a-ju jag-eun jo-gag-e bul-gwa-haess-da-neun geol kkae-dal-ass-da.
story.en: Under the lights, she shone. In that moment, Haneul realized everything he thought he knew about her had only ever been the smallest fragment of who she was.

story.text: 공연이 끝나고, 텅 빈 무대를 한참 바라보던 그는 혼잣말처럼 중얼거렸다. '…뭔가, 되게 벅차네요.' 무슨 감정인지 스스로도 정확히 설명할 수 없었다.
story.reading: gong-yeon-i kkeut-na-go, teong bin mu-dae-reul han-cham ba-ra-bo-deon geu-neun hon-jan-mal-cheo-reom jung-eol-geo-ryeoss-da. '…mwon-ga, doe-ge beok-cha-ne-yo.' mu-seun gam-jeong-in-ji seu-seu-ro-do jeong-hwag-hi seol-myeong-hal su eobs-eoss-da.
story.en: After the show ended, he stared at the empty stage for a long while before muttering to himself. '...This is — really overwhelming.' He couldn't quite explain, even to himself, what exactly he was feeling.

story.text: 집으로 돌아가는 길, 하늘은 문득 깨달았다. 팬으로서 느낀 감동인지, 그 사람을 향한 마음인지, 이제는 그 경계가 잘 보이지 않았다.
story.reading: jib-eu-ro dol-a-ga-neun gil, ha-neul-eun mun-deuk kkae-dal-ass-da. paen-eu-ro-seo neu-kkin gam-dong-in-ji, geu sa-ram-eul hyang-han ma-eum-in-ji, i-je-neun geu gyeong-gye-ga jal bo-i-ji anh-ass-da.
story.en: On the way home, it hit him — he could no longer clearly tell where the thrill of being a fan ended and where his feelings for her began. The line between the two had all but disappeared.

words.example_en: I went to a concert for the first time.
The venue was filled with roaring cheers.
A wave of emotion overwhelmed him.

sentences.en: I went to something called a concert for the first time.

sentences.ko: 무대 위의 그녀는 완전히 달라 보였다.
sentences.reading: mu-dae wi-ui geu-nyeo-neun wan-jeon-hi dal-la bo-yeot-da
sentences.en: She looked completely different up on the stage.
The crowd erupted in cheers the moment her name was called.
His heart felt overwhelmed in a way he couldn't explain.
She shone brilliantly under the lights.
